text: 'Answer questions from our docs' sounds simple, but it isn't a requirement yet -- it doesn't say what happens when the docs don't cover something.
So this one gets pinned down to three conditions: every answer must be grounded in, and cite, the real documents -- never invented.
When the docs don't cover a question, the system has to say 'I don't know,' not guess.
And it has to be fast enough to actually beat emailing Priya's or Omar's team and waiting for a reply.
Next: scoping V1 honestly -- what this project ships, and what it deliberately doesn't.
